#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root=$1
export JEFE_SOCKET_DIR="$root/sockets"
socket_for() {
  output=$(jefe doctor --config "$1" 2>&1 || true)
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in
      *"private socket isolation at "*)
        rest=${line#*private socket isolation at }
        printf '%s\n' "${rest%%;*}"
        return 0
        ;;
    esac
  done <<EOF
$output
EOF
  return 1
}
socket_a=$(socket_for "$root/config-a")
socket_b=$(socket_for "$root/config-b")
test -n "$socket_a"
test -n "$socket_b"
test "$socket_a" != "$socket_b"
cleanup() { tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket_a" kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket_b" kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket_a" new-session -d -s issue687-isolation '/bin/sleep 60'
tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket_a" has-session -t issue687-isolation
if tmux -f /dev/null -S "$socket_b" has-session -t issue687-isolation >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf 'CONFIG B SAW CONFIG A SESSION\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf 'DIFFERENT CONFIG CANNOT SEE SESSION\n'
